title: Time Bank
description: A hardcore survival plugin where players have limited lifespan based on real playtime. Time is tradeable as physical crystals, creating a unique time-based economy!
body:
# ⏰ Time Bank - Hardcore Survival with Time as Currency

A hardcore survival plugin where **your life is literally on the clock**. Players have a limited lifespan based on real playtime, and time itself becomes the ultimate tradeable resource.

## 💀 The Concept

Every player starts with a limited amount of time (default: 3 hours, configurable). Time drains in real-time while you're online - 1 second per second. When your time reaches zero, you're **permanently banned** from the server.

But here's the twist: **time is a physical resource**. You can extract your remaining time into **Time Crystals** - tradeable items that can be sold, stolen, or given away. This creates a unique economy where your life is literally in your hands.

## ✨ Key Features

### 💎 Time Crystal System
- **Shift + right-click** with a clock to open the extraction menu
- Extract 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, or 100 hours into physical Time Crystals
- **Right-click** a crystal to consume it and gain the hours back
- Crystals are fully tradeable, droppable, and stealable - protect them with your life!

### ⚔️ High-Stakes PvP
- Kill a player → victim loses **30 minutes**, killer gains **15 minutes**
- Creates intense risk-reward combat scenarios
- Encourages alliances, betrayals, and strategic gameplay

### 🎁 Earning Time (Hardcore Mode)
Time is precious and hard to earn:
- **Mob kills**: 10% chance to drop 1-3 minutes
- **Rare ores**: Mining diamond, emerald, or ancient debris gives 1-3 minutes
- **Advancements**: Normal (+5 min), Challenge (+10 min)
- All rewards fully configurable (can be set to 0 for ultra-hardcore)

### ☀️ Revive System
- Rare **Revive Beacons** can bring time-banned players back to life
- Right-click to open a menu and select who to revive
- Revived players get default starting time
- Admin command: `/revive <player>`

### 💀 Death Penalties
- **Natural deaths** (fall damage, drowning, mobs): -10 minutes
- **PvP deaths**: -30 minutes (killer gains 15 minutes)
- All penalties configurable

### 📊 Display Options
- Real-time action bar showing remaining time: `⏰ 2h 45m remaining`
- Optional: Show time above player heads
- Optional: Show time in tab list
- Color-coded: Green (>1h), Red (<1h)

### 🛠️ Admin Tools
- `/settime <player> <time>` - Supports flexible formats: `5h`, `30m`, `2h30m`
- `/revive <player>` - Revive time-banned players
- Smart tab-completion for both commands
- Permission nodes: `timebank.settime`, `timebank.revive`

## ⚙️ Configuration

Everything is customizable in `config.yml`:
- Default starting time
- Maximum time cap (default: 20 hours for challenging gameplay)
- Death penalties
- Mob drop chances and amounts
- PvP time gain/loss
- Ore rewards
- Advancement rewards
- Display options
